Class Component

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.is25am31.model.components.Component
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
Direct Known Subclasses:
AlienLifeSupport, BatteryComponent, Cabin, Cannon, CargoHold, Engine, MainCabin, ShieldGenerator
public class Component extends Object implements Serializable
Represents a general component in the game, serving as the base class for various specialized components. This class handles the management of component properties such as orientation, position, and connections to other components.
Subclasses of this class are designed to override and extend its functionality to represent specific types of components.
